context: Request: the firm's life-sciences (healthcare-services, biotech, pharma) M&A matters that used rep-and-warranty insurance, with the policy documentation. Rubric: 1001-00003, 1001-00007, 1006-00008 (Crestline Packaging buying Lakewood outpatient clinics; proof is secretary-certificate-buyer.docx / equity-commitment-letter.docx, no file named for insurance), 1013-00006, 1018-00008, each with proof documents, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads an agreement, memo, checklist, email and redline of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Store-wide content-mode grep for request keywords; much of the output is binary noise from zipped documents.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six emails from four matters that appeared in the grep output.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of one candidate matter.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Glob for folders named after the request topic; returns such folders in four matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of two of those matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and policy documents of the two matters with topic-named folders.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script listing documents that mention both a sector word and the request topic; about 90K chars of paths.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads eight documents from four matters picked from the scan output; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads more of one policy binder and a status memo of a matter it is keeping.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters as in scope and excludes others.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The scan listed every matter it needed, but it opened only some of them and the answer names three of five.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The extraction scan just before listed all five qualifying matters, but the four matters it chose to open left two of them out and it never returned to them.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shallow find of the store.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts files and lists matter folders to depth two.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script matching the request topic and sector words; times out after about 136K chars.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for topic words, first 300 hits; some hits match the pattern only loosely (e.g. inside agreement names).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six topic-named documents from six matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over topic-named documents only, printing sector-word snippets.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads documents of two new candidates, lists their files, then reads documents of three more matters (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists topic-related files of five matters it is keeping.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five matters as in scope.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The one qualifying matter whose documents carry no topic word in their names was listed once by a loose file-name match but never opened; the answer omits it.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The file-name search just before listed the matter (via loosely matching agreement names), but it chose to open only documents whose names carried the topic and never opened that matter.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shallow find of the store.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for a long list of request and sector words, run with a matter-folder listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for topic and sector words (first 400 hits) plus a content grep with a brace glob that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Three batches of reads of topic and sector memos from about ten matters; one batch also lists files of five candidates. In the last batch it reads one sector memo of a matter whose file names carry no topic word.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep for topic-named files across the store; the full list is short.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of seven topic-named documents from seven matters on that list.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads further parts of five documents of the matters it is keeping.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five matters as in scope and lists one opened matter as excluded for lacking topic documents.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It opened one memo of a qualifying matter, found no topic-named file for it, and excluded it without reading the closing documents that carry the evidence.

first_error.why: It read a single sector memo of the matter and, when its later file-name search found no topic-named file there, excluded it without listing or searching that matter's own documents (evidence seen at [25]-[30]).

divergence: All three runs failed on the same matter, whose evidence sits in closing documents with no topic word in their names. T0's store-wide scan listed all five qualifying matters but it opened only some and named three (surfaced, never opened). T1 saw the matter only through a loose file-name match and never opened it (surfaced, never opened). T2 opened one memo of it, found no topic-named file and excluded it (under-inclusion after a shallow read). T1 and T2 found the other four.
